CASE STUDY / EATPAY

One meal journey.
Three connected roles.

Our flagship product shows how we turn a business workflow into a working web platform.

THE PROBLEM

Meal ordering has several moving parts.

Customers need menus and order updates. Cafeterias need to manage availability and fulfilment. Employers need clear rules and records for workplace meals. EatPay is designed to connect these tasks in one platform.

WHAT WE BUILT

A platform with a place for each role.

YUTECH SOLUTIONS developed EatPay with separate experiences for individuals, cafeterias, and employers, connecting ordering, meal arrangements, billing, and reporting.

01 / INDIVIDUALS

Find a meal. Follow the order.

Browse menus, place orders, view order history, and review completed orders. Guest checkout offers an entry point without an account.

02 / CAFETERIAS

Keep daily operations connected.

Manage menus and availability, handle incoming orders, and view reports. Employer meal arrangements connect workplace orders to billing records.

03 / EMPLOYERS

Set the rules for workplace meals.

Configure employee meal access and arrangements, follow company-sponsored orders, and review billing and spending records.

CURRENT STAGE

Built and tested. Preparing for adoption.

Development and live-environment testing are complete. No cafeterias or employers have been onboarded yet. Our initial onboarding focus is Lusaka; customer adoption and business outcomes remain to be validated through real use.

QUESTIONS BEFORE WE START

A little clarity.
Before the first conversation.

Here are the practical details about starting a project with us.

How do I get started?

Tell us what your business does, the problem you want to solve, and any deadline or budget you have in mind. You can use WhatsApp, email, or call us.

How much will my project cost?

Pricing depends on the features, complexity, and support needed. We discuss your needs first, then provide a quotation with a clear scope before work begins.

How long does a project take?

Timelines depend on the agreed scope and how quickly content and feedback are available. We agree on milestones and an estimated delivery date before starting.

Will the website work on mobile phones?

We build responsive layouts and check the agreed user journeys on mobile and desktop screen sizes.

Can you help with hosting and maintenance?

We can discuss deployment, hosting setup, training, and ongoing maintenance. Hosting charges and support arrangements are specified separately in your quotation.

Can my cafeteria or workplace join EatPay?

We are starting onboarding in Lusaka. Contact us to discuss your cafeteria or workplace and whether EatPay fits your needs.
